title: Spies
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
in today’s true Bible lesson
we see that Moses 
sends 12 spies to check out the promised land.

DID YOU KNOW: 
10 of the 12 spies came back with BAD reports 
about the land that God had promised to give them
and 
only 2 spies, Caleb and Joshua, 
came back with GOOD reports about the promised land!
Why don’t you play I SPY WITH MY LITTLE EYE with your family
Make BINOCULARS - to keep your eyes on JESUS

YOU WILL NEED
2 empty toilet rolls
String
Tape
And your imagaination

PRAYER TIME
Dear Lord Jesus
Thank you for keeping your promises.
Please help me to keep my eyes on You
and to always trust You.
Amen
